rule: GOAL: Match the highlighted panel’s pattern to its inverted mini-map. CONTROLS: Click individual blocks to toggle their color. RULE: Mini-maps invert colors: white means red, gray means blue. TRAP: Believing mini-maps show current state directly, not an inverted target.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to place the yellow block into the bracketed slot. CONTROLS: Red arrows rotate the ring one step forward; green arrows rotate it backward. RULE: The ring’s cyclic order stays fixed, so only rotation changes which block sits in the target slot. TRAP: Assuming the corner brackets mark a starting position rather than the required ending position.

GOAL: Reduce the board to a single remaining peg. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click an empty spot to jump over an adjacent peg into that spot. RULE: A move is only valid if you jump directly over an adjacent peg into an empty space immediately beyond it. TRAP: Assuming you can jump over empty spaces or multiple pegs at once; only single, immediate jumps are allowed.

GOAL: Match the grid pattern to the reference image. CONTROLS: Click cells to toggle their color. RULE: White cells in the reference mean the target color is orange. TRAP: Assuming gray means orange, causing wasted clicks and a failed attempt.

GOAL: Place the purple square exactly over the center of the purple ring. CONTROLS: Clicking a target cell moves the white piece there, pulling the gray piece to the midpoint between the two pieces. RULE: The puzzle is solved only when the square’s center aligns perfectly with the ring’s center. TRAP: Assuming the gray piece needs to be on the ring; it merely follows the white piece and should not be the focus.

GOAL: Rotate the plug to align its prongs with the socket's pins. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug three cells per press; SPACE rotates it ninety degrees. RULE: Rotation occurs around the plug's top-left bounding box corner, not its center. TRAP: Assuming rotation happens around the geometric center leads to misaligned prongs and wasted moves.

GOAL: Collect the single plus marker to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character one step on the grid. RULE: Touching the plus marker instantly registers it as collected. TRAP: Assuming you must carry the item to a specific target zone to finish.

GOAL: Paint specific grid cells orange to match the panel patterns. CONTROLS: Click cells to switch their color from red to orange. RULE: Each panel reveals the target colors for its surrounding grid section. TRAP: Assuming panels show current state rather than the final required pattern.

GOAL: Arrange blocks to match target patterns using limited moves. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate color lanes; click blocks to swap positions. RULE: Rotations shift all colors in a lane simultaneously, preserving relative order. TRAP: Thinking individual blocks can be moved independently; only whole lanes rotate.

GOAL: Guide the charcoal box into the right ring. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active box; clicks swap control between boxes. RULE: Pushing a box sends it sliding through the purple door to the other room. TRAP: Thinking both boxes must stay in their starting rooms, or that doors block all movement.

GOAL: Change specific tiles to Orange while keeping the rest Blue, using the fewest clicks possible. CONTROLS: Clicking a tile cycles its color; each click counts toward the limit. RULE: Grey tiles behave exactly like Blue ones, so they require no changes. TRAP: Assuming Grey tiles need conversion leads to wasted clicks and potential failure.

GOAL: Place yellow and orange blocks into matching target slots on opposite rings. CONTROLS: Left and right buttons rotate their respective rings; red turns counter-clockwise, green clockwise. RULE: Rings share two cells, allowing blocks to transfer between sides only when aligned with these junctions. TRAP: Assuming one rotation affects both rings simultaneously; each ring moves independently, requiring separate steps to transfer items.

ESTABLISHED: Two bars shrink at an identical rate regardless of movement, indicating they are a single shared timer rather than progress indicators. FAILED: Assuming the bars track individual progress or that the goal is simply reaching the opposite pocket ends has not cleared the level. GOAL IS NOT: The objective is not merely reaching specific corner coordinates, nor is the timer tied to distance traveled or individual block status. CONTROLS: Pressing right moves the left block right and the right block left simultaneously, causing them to collide or merge if they meet in narrow paths.

ESTABLISHED: Level 1 remains unsolved despite exceeding the time budget. The two podium shapes are decorative, not target outlines. FAILED: Clicking pieces directly and clicking empty slots produced no movement or state changes. GOAL IS NOT: Matching piece unions to the podium geometry or a dress-up mechanic. CONTROLS: Clicking pieces and empty grid spaces currently does nothing, suggesting the required interaction is undiscovered.

GOAL: Move each block into the opposite pocket to complete the swap. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in the same direction. RULE: The wide side pockets allow the blocks to pass each other, unlike the narrow top corridor. TRAP: Trying to cross in the top bar is impossible because the blocks collide and cannot share a cell.

ESTABLISHED: The gray block is a delayed echo, replaying your exact path six steps behind. FAILED: Trying to outrun the echo by stopping or reversing direction, assuming it was a chaser. GOAL IS NOT: Reaching the exit before the gray block arrives, as it merely mirrors your movement. CONTROLS: Up, Down, Left, Right move the player; the gray block copies these moves with a fixed lag.

GOAL: Connect two points with a line without touching obstacles. CONTROLS: Click to place endpoints; drag to adjust position. RULE: The line must pass through the center of the target ring. TRAP: Assuming endpoints could touch obstacles; they must remain clear of all shapes.

GOAL: Guide the sliding block to the target square. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block; clicks toggle wall orientation. RULE: Walls block movement only when oriented perpendicular to the path. TRAP: Assuming toggles happen automatically; you must manually click to align walls before moving.

GOAL: Place the yellow and orange pieces into their matching bracket slots. CONTROLS: Red arrows move pieces forward; green arrows reverse the last move. RULE: Horizontal and vertical controls act independently on different axes. TRAP: Assuming green cancels all moves; it only undoes the single previous action.

GOAL: Rotate the logo three times to match the screen while keeping the energy bar full. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the block one step; standing on special tiles triggers rotation or refills energy. RULE: Every third cover tile rotates the logo, so you must visit them in a specific sequence to align the pattern. TRAP: Assuming you can refill energy anywhere; you must return to the exact start tile or run out of moves before matching the screen.

GOAL: Position the black shape so its mirror reflection covers the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the black piece; the reflection moves symmetrically across the vertical axis. RULE: Horizontal moves flip direction for the reflection, while vertical moves remain identical. TRAP: Assuming independent control of the reflection; it is strictly bound to the original shape's position.

GOAL: Align two yellow markers on the grid's designated target cells. CONTROLS: Red buttons rotate rows or serpentine paths; green buttons reverse those rotations. RULE: The grid functions as interconnected loops where pieces shift position but never change color. TRAP: Assuming the top row is isolated; it is actually part of the larger serpentine cycle, so rotating the whole path moves top-row pieces too.

GOAL: Position four green and two purple shapes so their combined center lands exactly on a target ring. CONTROLS: Click a shape to grab it, then click a black area to drop it there. RULE: Only the group's average position matters, so individual shapes can wander as long as the center hits the mark. TRAP: Believing shapes must stay in tight clusters wastes moves; let them spread out to fine-tune the center without blocking valid drop spots.

GOAL: Direct the reflection onto the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the vertical mirror line left or right; Space rotates it. RULE: The line only moves horizontally, but rotating it changes the reflection's vertical position. TRAP: Believing vertical arrows would move the source or mirror vertically, wasting actions on no-ops.

GOAL: Guide two blocks to collide in the bottom chamber. CONTROLS: Arrows move blocks simultaneously. RULE: Both blocks react to every input at once. TRAP: Assuming blocks move independently wastes time.

GOAL: Transform the grid to a single color in nine moves. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell flips that cell and its orthogonal neighbors. RULE: A click is a toggle, not a paint; mixed states flip independently. TRAP: Assuming clicks set a uniform color wastes turns when neighbors differ.

GOAL: Move two black shapes across a horizontal line to reflect them onto yellow targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; Space cycles selection between the line and the two shapes. RULE: Shapes must cross the line to mirror their position relative to it, landing on the target zones. TRAP: Assuming the line stays fixed; moving the line first reduces total steps by aligning the reflection axis optimally.

GOAL: Guide each box to its matching hole by pushing it into the correct room. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected box one step; clicks select a specific box. RULE: A box is placed only when it fully covers its target hole, completing the ring. TRAP: Believing you can push a box through a wall; boxes stop at boundaries, so plan paths around obstacles first.

GOAL: Move the U-shaped piece seven spaces to the right to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected object; Spacebar cycles through available shapes. RULE: Pressing Spacebar twice from the line selects the bar, implying the U is the intermediate selection. TRAP: Assuming the U piece was unselectable because its holes appeared blue instead of white.

GOAL: Cover the screen glyph with the block, then push it to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block one step per press. RULE: The block must fully obscure the blue glyph to unlock the path. TRAP: Thinking you could slide past the glyph without stopping; you must halt exactly on top of it to register the cover.

GOAL: Carry the podium icon to the exit by navigating a grid of colored bars. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token; side buttons rotate corresponding bars to clear paths. RULE: Standing on the icon transfers it to the control panel, unlocking its associated bar. TRAP: Assuming the icon is just scenery; ignoring that stepping on it is the only way to activate the final rotation needed to win.

GOAL: Fill every bracket with matching yellow blocks. CONTROLS: Clicking an arrow rotates its arms or spins the outer ring. RULE: Each asterisk operates independently; blocks never jump between centers. TRAP: Assuming blocks could move between asterisks wasted time on impossible transfers.

ESTABLISHED: The boat is trapped beneath a black box in the water room. Three green blocks sit inside this box, with one directly above the boat. FAILED: Rising the boat further is blocked by the box's solid bottom frame. GOAL IS NOT: The pink cross in the ceiling is not the current objective. CONTROLS: Movement shifts the camera; the boat floats up until hitting obstacles.

ESTABLISHED: The stamp tips 45 degrees clockwise with DOWN or RIGHT; the block is solid and cannot be pushed or overlapped by the fill. FAILED: Attempting to stamp through the block or treating the block as a target for direct overlap; the frame does not accept the stamp from the current side. GOAL IS NOT: To push the block or stamp directly into it from the side; the target is not the block's current position but requires approaching from a different angle. CONTROLS: DOWN and RIGHT tip the stamp clockwise; UP and LEFT tip it counter-clockwise; the stamp rotates around its corners while transl

GOAL: Move two pieces to their targets using a shared pivot point. CONTROLS: Click a piece, then click a valid black cell to slide it. Click the pivot to swap pieces. RULE: The pivot must be the exact midpoint between the current and target positions of a moving piece. TRAP: Assuming the pivot must lie on the grid line; it can be any black cell, even if the path seems long.

GOAL: Move the boat to the ceiling and remove the overhead block. CONTROLS: Arrows steer the boat; clicking a block destroys it. RULE: The boat floats upward only when unobstructed, allowing vertical travel through open gaps. TRAP: Assuming the block’s column position matched the boat’s exact center without verifying screen alignment.

GOAL: Paint the lower block section purple and the upper section white. CONTROLS: Arrows tumble the brush into new positions; Space stamps the current color; clicks select colors. RULE: Tumbling rotates the brush, so each resting spot stamps a specific geometric pattern onto the block. TRAP: Assuming arrows slide the brush flatly; they actually rotate it, changing the stamp shape and requiring precise positioning.

GOAL: Align all colored tiles to their target positions using a hidden cyclic permutation. CONTROLS: Arrow clicks shift the conveyor belt direction and speed. RULE: Each tile moves to the next position in a fixed, looping sequence. TRAP: Assuming clicks register instantly; some inputs may be ignored or offset, causing unexpected static states.

GOAL: Paint the upper-left area purple and the lower-right area orange. CONTROLS: Space stamps the selected color from the current corner; arrow keys rotate the stamping angle; clicking changes the active color. RULE: Stamping from a corner fills the entire triangular half of the grid opposite that corner. TRAP: Believing you must navigate before selecting a color wastes moves; choose your color while moving to save steps.

GOAL: Move the shape and lines into the yellow target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the selected item; Space cycles selection between shape, horizontal, and vertical lines. RULE: Selection is invisible; track cycles mentally to know which object responds to arrow presses. TRAP: Assuming arrows move everything simultaneously; they only affect the currently selected item, causing wasted moves.

GOAL: Guide the token to the yellow prize by rotating red and purple bars to form a continuous path. CONTROLS: Arrows move the token; clicks rotate specific colored bars between horizontal and vertical states. RULE: Bars must not overlap; rotating a bar into an occupied space is blocked, so plan rotations before moving. TRAP: Assuming the red bar can cross the purple path while horizontal; it must be vertical to bridge the gap.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking activates an object, turning it white while others revert to color. Mated pairs remain gray if stationary. Rotation via SPACE occurs on the active object. FAILED: Theoretical rotation calculations based on Level 1 data were inconclusive due to potential symmetry or counting errors. GOAL IS NOT: Avoiding body overlap between objects, as the game may permit it. CONTROLS: Click to select. SPACE rotates active object 90 degrees. Arrow keys move the active object.

GOAL: Rotate blue and move both pieces to align prongs for mating. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected piece; space rotates it; click selects a piece. RULE: Rotation keeps the bounding box top-left fixed, changing prong direction. TRAP: Assuming rotation shifts the piece’s center instead of anchoring at the corner.

GOAL: Guide two blocks to collide after parking three dots to clear the path. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected blocks; clicks select or deselect dots and blocks. RULE: Blocks only move into black space; dots block movement until parked. TRAP: Believing blocks move freely; they stop if a dot or wall is in the way, wasting moves.

GOAL: Stamp purple on the top-left, red on the bottom-right, and orange across the middle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the press position; clicks select colors or tools; Space stamps the current color. RULE: The stamp only applies the currently loaded color, overwriting any previous patterns in its footprint. TRAP: Assuming Space retained the last selected color; clicking a new color resets the loaded ink immediately.

ESTABLISHED: Three separate lanes exist, each with independent yellow markers. Each lane has a movable prefix section and a main track. Goal positions are at the end of each lane. FAILED: Treating the puzzle as a single unified sequence or assuming all arrows affect all lanes simultaneously did not work. GOAL IS NOT: A single global counter or a shared position for all yellows. CONTROLS: Main arrows shift all lanes simultaneously. Prefix arrows rotate only the top segment of their specific lane.

GOAL: Align two crossing lines to split a yellow pattern and position objects correctly. CONTROLS: Arrows move the currently selected line or object; clicks select a specific piece. RULE: Only the selected item responds to arrow keys; everything else stays still. TRAP: Assuming all lines move together or that clicks deselect items, causing wasted turns.

GOAL: Fill the block with four colored sections. CONTROLS: Click colors to load, click cartridge to stamp, space to rotate press. RULE: Press orientation dictates which grid quadrant receives the stamp. TRAP: Believing rotation moves the cartridge, when it only changes the stamp's angle relative to the fixed press.

GOAL: Move two blocks into matching holes using a single pusher character. CONTROLS: Arrows move the pusher; moving into a block pushes it one step. RULE: Only the green block can push; yellow blocks are passive targets. TRAP: Thinking movement costs equal time; the timer drains irregularly, not one-to-one per action.

GOAL: Collect three palette items and deliver the final color to the exit zone without triggering hazards. CONTROLS: Arrows move the character; entering specific cells collects items or triggers ejections. RULE: Each palette visit changes the logo color sequentially; the exit only opens for the correct final color. TRAP: Wasting actions on back-and-forth moves or ignoring ejection zones that throw you off course.

GOAL: Park the blue dot out of the corridor, then slide both mirrored blocks until they meet in the center. CONTROLS: Click to select the dot or blocks. Arrows move the selection; blocks move in opposite directions. RULE: Blocks mirror each other’s movement across the center, so a single arrow press moves both pieces simultaneously. TRAP: Forgetting to deselect the dot before moving blocks wastes actions, as arrows only affect the currently selected item.

GOAL: Slide the charcoal and green pieces to lock their prongs against the anchor piece. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected piece; clicks select a new piece. RULE: Prongs must align tip-to-tip with corresponding slots on other pieces to secure the structure. TRAP: Assuming a piece is locked when only one prong aligns; both prongs must connect to stabilize the assembly.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking the key's center or stem restarts the level. The orange socket and black areas are blocked. FAILED: Clicking different parts of the key to "use" it. Diagonal moves and single steps are invalid. GOAL IS NOT: Moving the B peg into the pipe via standard jumps. CONTROLS: Clicking the key resets the puzzle. Standard jumps capture adjacent pegs to land behind.

GOAL: Paint a grid by stamping overlapping colored regions to match target patterns. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate your stamp orientation; clicks select colors and place stamps on the board. RULE: Later stamps cover earlier ones, so apply colors in strict reverse order of their visibility. TRAP: Assuming stamps are permanent; forgetting to re-apply the topmost color after lower layers causes mismatched cells.

GOAL: Clear yellow by moving lines to reflect and remove hidden blocks. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected lines or blocks; clicks select targets. RULE: Lines act as mirrors; moving them reflects blocks to clear hidden areas. TRAP: Clicking empty space deselects; ensure you click solid block dots to select specific objects before moving.

ESTABLISHED: Water remains unequalized despite an open channel. FAILED: Moving the boat right and destroying blocks did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply connecting water bodies or destroying specific blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the boat; mouse clicks destroy blocks.

ESTABLISHED: The level has a strict click budget, likely around sixty moves, with no lethal hazards present. FAILED: Excessive probing and inefficient move sequences exhausted the entire budget, causing a timeout failure. GOAL IS NOT: Surviving hazards or managing health; the objective is strictly completing the puzzle within the move limit. CONTROLS: Clicking elements moves them; clicking a new area transfers control, counting as one move against the total budget.

GOAL: Slide the player from the start to the blue tile using arrow keys. CONTROLS: Arrows make the player slide until hitting a wall or a colored tile. RULE: The player stops exactly on white tiles, sliding over gray ones without stopping. TRAP: Assuming the player stops on every tile; sliding over gray tiles wastes moves if you expect a stop.

GOAL: Slide the gray wall to align the yellow marker with the black bar's gap. CONTROLS: Click the top blue button to shift the wall left, and the bottom button to shift it right. RULE: The yellow strip only passes through the opening when the wall's edge matches the gap's position. TRAP: Assume the wall moves diagonally or rotates; it only translates horizontally, so ignore vertical alignment concerns.

GOAL: Fit four interlocking pieces into a single assembly without overlap. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece, Space rotates it, Clicks select a new piece. RULE: Pieces lock only when opposite prongs align perfectly at shared coordinates. TRAP: Assuming rotation happens around the center; it actually pivots on the anchor point, shifting position unexpectedly.

GOAL: Match the yellow plug and socket by setting the five switches to the correct pattern. CONTROLS: Click each switch to toggle its state between black and gray. RULE: The correct switch configuration aligns the plug and socket, causing them to connect. TRAP: Assuming the board updates visually for every click; it only changes when the final solution is entered.

GOAL: Guide the square to the center using limited moves. CONTROLS: Click a distant dot to jump the square there. RULE: Dots between the start and end positions shift toward the start. TRAP: Assuming dots above the square move; they stay fixed, allowing long chains.

GOAL: Slide the bottom strip so its columns perfectly align with the gap above it. CONTROLS: Left buttons shift the top gray area; right buttons slide the bottom strip sideways. RULE: Moving the strip right shrinks the middle section; if the middle vanishes, the strip stops moving. TRAP: Clicking the strip button repeatedly fails once the middle section disappears, requiring a left-button click to restore space first.

GOAL: Align five spinning columns to match target colors by moving a cursor between them. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows shift the cursor; Up and Down arrows rotate the current column’s color cycle. RULE: Columns cycle through seven states; moving up decreases the index, moving down increases it, allowing you to find the correct match. TRAP: Assuming all columns require the same number of presses wastes time; each needs a unique rotation count based on its current state.

GOAL: Arrange the four bottom colors into the empty slots to match the sequence shown by the colored rings at the top of the screen. CONTROLS: Click a color at the bottom to pick it up, then click a specific slot in the center box to drop it there. RULE: Placing a color swaps it with whatever was in that slot, so you must track where the displaced items land. TRAP: Thinking you can place items directly; failing to account for the swap mechanic leaves stray colors in the wrong slots.

GOAL: Catch the falling liquid by aligning the bar's ends precisely with the cup openings to fill both containers. CONTROLS: Use the arrow keys to slide the horizontal bar left or right, and press the spacebar to release the liquid. RULE: The liquid splits and pours just outside the bar's ends, so the bar must span exactly the gap between the cups. TRAP: Assuming the liquid falls directly beneath the bar's center; it actually pours from the edges, requiring careful end alignment.

ESTABLISHED: The frame's gray interior has been overwritten by the player's movement, indicating destructive interaction or filling. FAILED: Pressing SPACE while touching the frame border did not trigger a win or visible change. GOAL IS NOT: Simply standing near the frame or pressing action buttons without fully covering the interior area. CONTROLS: Movement overwrites frame contents; SPACE interacts with adjacent objects but currently yields no result at the border.

GOAL: Align colored strips with markers by shifting five horizontal bands to specific rows. CONTROLS: Four buttons move adjacent band pairs vertically; left moves top up, right moves top down. RULE: Each click shifts two bands equally, forcing coupled movement that requires balancing opposing actions. TRAP: Assuming clicks are independent; moving one band inadvertently shifts its neighbor, causing blockages if order is ignored.

GOAL: Arrange seven puzzle pieces to match the hidden target sequence shown on the pink bar. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selector between pieces; UP and DOWN rotate the selected piece through seven possible orientations. RULE: Each piece has a unique valid orientation; the cycle length is seven, so the shortest path is always three steps or fewer. TRAP: Assuming all pieces start at the same orientation wastes time; you must check the current state of each piece before rotating.

GOAL: Align the red block with the target slot to collect the next item. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plug; left/right shifts the red block horizontally; up/down moves it vertically. RULE: The red block must overlap the target’s exact position to be collected. TRAP: Moving the red block into the target column before vertical alignment causes collisions or misses.

GOAL: Merge two same-colored pieces to form a larger yellow square and clear the level. CONTROLS: Click a cell to move a nearby piece there, triggering merges if conditions are met. RULE: Pieces merge if the clicked cell is within Euclidean distance eight of a same-colored piece. TRAP: Assuming merge range is small or based on piece proximity; the rule actually measures distance from the click point.

GOAL: Reach the green exit while avoiding the patrolling guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one space; the guard moves toward you. RULE: The guard lunges only when you are exactly two spaces away in a straight line. TRAP: Moving directly toward the guard from three spaces away triggers a fatal lunge.

GOAL: Place three 4x4 blocks into empty slots to complete a picture. CONTROLS: Arrows move the block or the picker; Space grabs or drops the block. RULE: You can only carry one block at a time and must align it perfectly with an empty slot. TRAP: Assuming you can slide a block horizontally while carrying it; you must drop it to change direction or position.

GOAL: Navigate the grid to reach the exit while avoiding three stationary guards. CONTROLS: Use arrow keys to move one step in cardinal directions. RULE: Guards only attack if you stop directly in front of them; passing through their line of sight during a multi-step move is safe. TRAP: Believing guards turn to track you; they remain fixed, so timing your arrival to avoid head-on landings is key.

ESTABLISHED: The sliding marker's 2x2 color arrangement (horizontal or vertical split) depends on move direction. The keypad and card remain visually static when clicked. FAILED: Clicking the card, its dots, or the socket border produced no change. Brute-forcing dial positions without matching the code failed. GOAL IS NOT: Simply aligning the marker to a specific column without regard for the color pattern or keypad input. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the marker and flip its color split. Keypad clicks register input but do not alter the marker or card visuals.

GOAL: Fill sockets by finding the correct colored pieces. CONTROLS: Click pieces to swap their positions. Press space to test the current setup. RULE: Sockets light up in a specific sequence, revealing the required piece for each slot. TRAP: Assuming the pattern continues simply; the missing hole changes the order, requiring careful testing of remaining pieces.

GOAL: Position two crosses so their arms align with four matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross three spaces; Space toggles which cross moves. RULE: Only the cross marked by the white indicator responds to arrow keys. TRAP: Assuming both crosses move simultaneously wastes moves; you must toggle to move each one separately.

GOAL: Fill the red, green, and blue boxes with specific colored blocks to match the top sockets. CONTROLS: Click a block at the bottom to pick it up, then click an empty box slot to place it. Press space to confirm. RULE: Each colored box has a fixed capacity; green and blue boxes hold two blocks, red holds one. TRAP: Assuming any block fits any slot regardless of box color limits wastes moves and resets progress.

GOAL: Arrange colors into two connected boxes to match a specific target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a color at the bottom, then click an empty slot to place it. RULE: A hole token must bridge the two boxes, forcing the fixed green color to align with the target's position. TRAP: Assuming colors could be placed in any order; the hole's placement dictates the entire chain.

GOAL: Arrange tokens so the sequence of colors matches the hidden target string. CONTROLS: Click a token to pick it up, then click a slot to place it. Press space to test the arrangement. RULE: Empty slots count as three identical blue tokens, creating a repeating pattern between red tokens. TRAP: Assuming every slot must hold a visible token wastes time; leaving specific slots empty is the key to matching the length.

GOAL: Move three shapes to cover their matching colored dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Each shape must fully cover all dots of its specific color. TRAP: Dots remain listed in the state even when covered; judge success by visual alignment, not dot removal.

GOAL: Fill nine empty sockets by chaining three colored rows in the exact order shown in the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click bottom tokens to place them into empty slots; click colored hole tokens to replace a row’s contents with a copy of another box’s row. RULE: Each hole token copies the row of the box matching its color, preserving the order of groups in the final chain. TRAP: Assuming holes are interchangeable ignores that each hole’s color dictates which specific box row it copies, breaking the sequence if misplaced.

GOAL: Fill four socket cells to unlock the exit. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color; arrows move the block. RULE: All four diamond-shaped socket cells must turn green simultaneously to pass. TRAP: Clicking the top socket cell first sometimes failed; retrying or checking the order fixed the stall.

GOAL: Reach the exit while dodging the bouncing orange block. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step in the chosen direction. RULE: The orange bounces off walls and moves two cells toward the player each turn. TRAP: Assuming the orange only moves one cell or stays still leads to fatal collisions.

GOAL: Make both colored bars reach length 26 so their dots land on the marked crosses. CONTROLS: Click top glyphs to extend bars; click bottom glyphs to shrink them. RULE: The level only completes when both dots simultaneously align with the target crosses. TRAP: Assuming a single dot landing on a cross wins; you must adjust both bars to the exact same length.

GOAL: Guide two blocks to specific pressure plates to open doors and clear the path. CONTROLS: Use arrow keys to slide the selected block until it hits a wall or obstacle. RULE: Plates keep doors open only while occupied; leaving a plate closes the door immediately. TRAP: Assuming doors stay open after a block moves off a plate, leading to trapped agents.

GOAL: Place two hole tokens and fill the resulting chain with pool colors to match the target pattern. CONTROLS: Click a token to select it, then click a slot to place it; use space to confirm the solution. RULE: The chain expands from the red box's row, requiring color assignments to satisfy both hole positions and fixed green constraints. TRAP: Assuming the blue hole token's center was at column 52 wasted a move, as it actually resided at column 55.

GOAL: Place three shapes to cover scattered dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; Space cycles to the next shape. RULE: Each shape covers dots only within its specific geometric bounds. TRAP: Assuming shapes stay active; Space cycles the selection, requiring careful tracking of which shape moves.

GOAL: Shrink the large tip to fit through the narrow gap. CONTROLS: Click keypad cells to resize; use arrows to move the tip. RULE: Shrinking keeps the top-left section; moving shifts the whole block. TRAP: Assuming the tip can slide sideways through the gap without resizing first.

GOAL: Merge two pieces to cover a circle center. CONTROLS: Click to move a piece; proximity triggers a merge. RULE: Merging creates a larger shape; clicking it moves it to cover the target. TRAP: Believing you must avoid all early merges; premature merges were fixable by moving the new shape to the goal.

GOAL: Grow the vine to full size so its prongs align with the U-shaped piece. CONTROLS: Arrows moved pieces. Space rotated the vine or triggered growth cycles. Clicks selected pieces. RULE: The vine grows and shrinks in stages; wait for it to reach maximum size before mating with the U. TRAP: Trying to place pieces while the vine was shrinking, wasting turns waiting for the cycle to restart.

GOAL: Navigate to the exit while avoiding a moving guard. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move one step per press. RULE: The guard follows a strict repeating path, allowing you to slip past during gaps. TRAP: Assuming you can wait in place is costly; the guard’s timing shifts with every move you make.

GOAL: Guide the glowing tip to the bottom-left cavity to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the tip in four directions. RULE: The tip fits only when its four-by-four shape aligns perfectly with open gray spaces. TRAP: Believing you could drop straight down failed; you had to shift left first to bypass the solid wall.

GOAL: Decode the hidden sequence by cycling through pattern slots to match the target color arrangement. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the cursor to select specific grid cells for inspection and rotation. RULE: The visible yellow bar segments directly mapped to the required order of blue pattern classes. TRAP: Hand-transcribing pattern strings introduced errors; relying on visual estimation instead of exact data caused repeated failures.

GOAL: Transform the top row to match the hidden target by tracing glyph connections through the middle row. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Down cycles the yellow bar glyphs. RULE: Each top glyph links to a middle glyph, which links to a specific yellow glyph shape. TRAP: Assuming the top and bottom rows match directly; they do not. You must follow the two-step chain through the center.

GOAL: Move the strip to the target row in the rightmost column. CONTROLS: Side buttons raise one fluid column while lowering its neighbor; center buttons activate gates when adjacent columns match. RULE: The strip only moves between columns when the gate opens, which requires the two neighboring fluid levels to be equal. TRAP: Trying to lower the destination column first fails because the strip must already be inside that column to move with the fluid.

GOAL: Move two shapes to cover matching dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece. Space switches pieces. RULE: Touching a color bay permanently changes your piece's color. TRAP: The color does not fade when you leave the bay.

GOAL: Guide the wire tip to the head by routing current through the side arm. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; keypad clicks trigger electrical checks. RULE: Current flows toward the socket, pulling the tip only when moving vertically through narrow gaps. TRAP: Believing horizontal current movement shifts the tip; it flows through the wire without dragging the tip sideways.

GOAL: Align two symbol bars by swapping tile glyphs to match required patterns. CONTROLS: Left and Right arrows cycle through tiles; Up and Down arrows change the selected tile's symbol. RULE: Tiles with two identical symbols must align with segments of two identical symbols in the target bars. TRAP: Assuming the cursor only cycles through tiles; it may also cycle through the bars themselves for direct editing.

GOAL: Clear the grid by defeating all patrolling guards using exactly twenty arrow moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one step per press, triggering simultaneous guard movement. RULE: Landing directly on a guard destroys it, clearing the cell instantly. TRAP: Assuming guards only move when you do; they move every turn, requiring precise timing to intercept them.

GOAL: Reach the exit by navigating past a dark red guard with extended vision. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character one step in the chosen direction. RULE: The dark red guard sees four cells ahead, forcing you to avoid its direct line of sight. TRAP: Assuming the dark red guard has the same short range as standard red guards causes fatal collisions.

GOAL: Turn three shapes blue by moving them to specific spots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active shape; space switches to the next shape. RULE: A shape turns blue only when it fully covers a dot cluster. TRAP: Assuming the white marker shows the active shape; it can vanish when a shape is on a target, requiring you to track the cycle manually.

ESTABLISHED: Pushing Q down moves it to rows 44-46, not the goal. The central plus structure shifts down when R is pushed, proving R is not immovable. Q stops at 44-46 because R slides away. FAILED: Assuming R blocks Q at 41-43. Assuming the plus is immovable without a lower anchor. GOAL IS NOT: Q stopping at 44-46. CONTROLS: Directional inputs slide selected boxes until blocked. Boxes push others if the path is clear.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking anywhere within a glyph’s 3x3 area registers. Panel cells respond to clicks. FAILED: Clicking outside glyph interiors or panel frames yields no effect. GOAL IS NOT: Simply clicking the center of every symbol. CONTROLS: Click glyph cells to grow or shrink specific colored shapes.

GOAL: Guide the green dot to the target by extending a chain of connected shapes. CONTROLS: Click a shape to grow it, pushing any touching shapes in the same direction. RULE: Growth is a chain reaction; one shape pushes the next only if their tips align perfectly. TRAP: Assuming you can move shapes independently; ignoring alignment causes blocked moves and wasted clicks.

ESTABLISHED: Collection works only when the cable’s tip hits the wall and that band holds exactly one remaining target. FAILED: Trying to collect multiple targets in one band, or collecting when other uncollected targets share the row. GOAL IS NOT: Simply grabbing every target in sequence regardless of their row placement. CONTROLS: Extend cable to hit the wall to grab. Move cable vertically to align with a single-target row before extending.
